description: Next results dates and SEC 10-Q/10-K filing windows of listed bitcoin holders (MSTR, COIN, MARA, HOOD and others): dates and windows from issuer and exchange sources. Takes optional { ticker, days_ahead (1-60, default 60) }. Returns { as_of, today, days_ahead, ticker, count, available, truncated, events[], full, disclaimer, cite, data_contract }; up to 5 events, soonest first, each with ticker, issuer, event_type, event_name, date_status, source_url, checked and either event_date (an issuer-announced date) or window_start/window_end with the SEC rule (a statutory window — never a date). date_status is the record's, verbatim: announced_primary_confirmed, occurred_primary_confirmed or unknown_exact_date_statutory_window. Example: {"ticker": "MSTR"} or {"days_ahead": 14}. Every row with history, rule locators and recorded outcomes: the per-call x402 route /api/paid/calendar (USDC), named with its price in `full`; the same rows stay free as JSON and CSV. Information, not financial advice. Every answer carries data_contract { source, as_of, status, corrections_url, license }. This server answers bounded questions, one question, one answer; for bulk, history, backfills and scheduled pulls use the CSVs and datapackage.json at https://coinbucha.com/data.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to look (1-60, default 60)

name: get_bitcoin_company_calendar
